items.headline: No. 1 Texas' Hero Kanu details experience in Red River Rivalry
items.description: Kanu joins SEC Now ahead of the Longhorns' matchup against Oklahoma to discuss the spectacle around one of college football's most historic rivalries and his interests outside of football.

items.headline: McGee Essay: Football, Legends, History - 'Red River Rivalry'
items.description: Ryan McGee dives into the legendary moments, rich history and storied tradition that make the 126-year rivalry between No. 1 Texas and Oklahoma one of college football's must-see matchups.

items.headline: College football's backup quarterback talent drain
items.description: How hard is it to get, hold on to and pay a backup QB in today's college football?

items.headline: Chizik, Stinchbomb reveal keys to winning the Red River Rivalry
items.description: No. 1 Texas and Oklahoma have had different trajectories this season, and analysts Gene Chizik and Matt Stinchcomb outline the keys for each program to earn a Week 6 win.

items.headline: Dari Nowkhah adjusts his SEC Network Power Rankings in Week 6
items.description: The top three teams on Nowkhah's list remain consistent while he breaks down a bit of a dilemma for the fourth spot between No. 14 Missouri and No. 17 Mississippi State.

items.headline: Defensive dynamic duos applying pressure around the SEC
items.description: The SEC Now crew analyzes the top defender duos from the conference, highlighting the performances from No. 1 Texas, No. 10 LSU, No. 14 Missouri and No. 2 Georgia.
